sections.content:
Whoa! When I clicked the magenta square at (36-37, 17-18), it moved! The square moved from (36-37, 17-18) to (35-36, 16-17). Looking at the diff:
- (35,16) B→M, (35,17) B→M, (36,16) B→M: new cells in the upper left
- (36,18) M→B, (37,17) M→B, (37,18) M→B: old cells in the lower right
So the 2x2 square moved 1 up and 1 to the left (diagonally). Interesting! So clicking a square moves it diagonally... in which direction? It moved to the upper left. Maybe clicking a square moves it one step toward the flower? The flower is at (23-31, 29-37), and the square is at (36,17) — the flower is to the upper right of the square, not the upper left. Hmm, no.
Wait, maybe clicking a square moves it toward the click point? I clicked (36,17), which is the upper-left cell of the square. And the square moved to the upper left. So clicking a cell of the square makes the square move in the direction of the clicked cell? That is, the square shifts so that the clicked cell becomes... hmm.
The square occupied (36,17), (36,18), (37,17), (37,18). I clicked (36,17) = upper-left cell. The new position: (35,16), (35,17), (36,16), (36,17). So the square shifted (-1,-1). The clicked cell (36,17) is now the lower-right cell of the new square. So the square moved in the direction of the clicked corner.
So: click a corner cell of the square → the square moves 1 step in that diagonal direction. This is like a "push" mechanic.
Now, what's the goal? Maybe the squares need to reach the flower? Or maybe the squares need to line up in some pattern?
Hmm, wait. Let me reconsider. Maybe the goal is to move the 4 magenta squares to specific positions. Where? The consumed dots (41,16), (40,37), (57,16), (54,49) are now empty. Maybe the squares need to be moved to the positions of the consumed dots? That seems weird.
Or, the goal is: move the squares to the 4 corners of the flower? Or onto the flower?
Let me think about the palette in the HUD: S, M, p, Y. Maybe the 4 squares need to be colored S, M, p, Y respectively? But they're all M.
Or, the goal is to move all 4 squares to the flower, and the flower blooms (turns yellow, matching the 4x4 Y in the HUD)?
Let me test: move the square at (35,16) toward the flower. The flower's center is (27,33). From (35,16), the direction is upper right (+1,-1... row -1, col +1). If I click the upper-right cell of the square (35,17), the square should move to the upper right.
Let me try clicking (35,17) and see if it moves to the upper right.
